title: Hayati Pro Max Plus Cherry Cola Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cherry Cola delivers the unmistakable mix of sweet Cherry and fizzy Cola in a smooth, nostalgic vape. The tangy Cherry note cuts through the classic soda sweetness for a lively, balanced flavour. Each Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod includes a prefilled 2ml pod with an integrated 10ml refill reservoir, totalling 12ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid. No need for messy refilling or coil replacements—just connect to the Hayati Pro Max + Prefilled Pod Kit and vape. Dual mesh coils ensure crisp, even flavour and smooth vapour production for up to 6000 puffs (approx.). Discover more flavours with our full selection of Hayati Pro Max Plus Pods .
